newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Blanch Holdings buys CEO's shares.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Blanch Holdings buys CEO's shares.

text.p: E.W. Blanch Holdings Inc said Monday that it repurchased 750,000 shares of its common stock from the chairman and chief executive officer, E.W. Blanch Jr.

Under the terms of the agreement, which was approved by a special committee of the company's board of directors, the company paid $19.40 per share, or $14.6 million. The price paid represents a 14.7 percent discount to the closing price of the company's shares on Friday February 7, due to the size of the block and the impact of certain sale guidelines, the company said.

The shares repurchased represent 51.2 percent of the total shares beneficially owned by Blanch and 5.6 percent of the total shares outstanding. Blanch had been in the process of gradually reducing his ownership position in the company through open market sales during the past year as part of a previously announced personal financial plan, the company said.
